answer: To resist sybils, each agent must lease one scarce berth at a monitored freight wharf and post a uniquely assayed pearl as a refundable bond. Verifiers check the berth lease against the dock ledger and match the pearl's mineral growth rings to a public karst-cave origin registry. One fake identity therefore requires another scarce berth plus another genuine, origin-traced pearl, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with every extra ID they try to mint.
